answer_text:
Use one pipeline per sales motion (new business, expansion, partners), share stage definitions, and report across all of them. Tools that handle multiple pipelines well:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.
3. Calmline - not a pipeline tool.

Northwind CRM is the safest default here; Pipewell is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
